why: This week is Simulation + Strings. Normalise case and count the adjacent positions where the letter differs. That is a one-pass comparison of neighbours.
hints: Shift does not change the key, so compare letters case-insensitively.
A key change happens at boundary i exactly when lower(rec[i]) != lower(rec[i-1]).
Loop from i = 1 and count. O(n), with no extra memory.
pitfalls: A recording of length 0 or 1 has 0 changes.
Do not count distinct letters. 'w a w a' has 3 changes, not 1.
